fields.headline: RIL allots ₹12,000 Cr NCDs at 7.47% (16 Sep); JP Morgan India Conference meetings 21 Sep; Jio IPO timing still open
fields.summary: On 16 Sep 2026 RIL allotted 12 lakh PPD Series Q unsecured NCDs aggregating ₹12,000 Cr at 7.47% p.a., maturing 16 Sep 2031 (CRISIL/CARE AAA). Executives held JP Morgan India Conference one-on-ones in Mumbai on 21 Sep with no UPSI disclosed. Jio Platforms has SEBI DRHP observations (28 Aug) but November listing timing remains market rumor, not company-confirmed.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed large AAA NCD raise supports liquidity; IR meetings routine; treat Jio IPO calendar as rumored only.

unknowns: Exact Nov Jio IPO pricing/window not company-confirmed

fields.headline: HDFC Bank board submits two MD & CEO names to RBI (12 Sep); ED pipeline expanded ahead of Jagdishan exit 26 Oct
fields.summary: Exchange filing/Bloomberg 12 Sep 2026: Board approved submitting two MD & CEO candidates (order of preference, 3-year term, remuneration) to RBI; names undisclosed. Also proposed reappointment of V. Srinivasa Rangan as ED (23 Nov 2026–22 Nov 2027), appointment of Jimmy Tata as ED (subject to RBI), and creation of a fourth WTD seat. Current CEO Sashidhar Jagdishan retires at close of business 26 Oct 2026. Broker notes treat RBI approval as near-term re-rating watch.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed succession filing removes process uncertainty but RBI pick/timing and candidate identity still open—med, not high.

unknowns: Candidate identities not disclosed by bank
RBI approval timing unknown

fields.headline: SBI advises customers ahead of UFBU nationwide bank strike 28–30 Sep 2026
fields.summary: On 21 Sep 2026 SBI issued a customer advisory ahead of a three-day United Forum of Bank Unions strike (28–30 Sep), noting branch disruption risk while ATMs, CSPs, YONO/UPI/digital channels are expected to remain available. Separately, media says SBI is in-principle anchor for Vi’s proposed funding package (primary for IDEA, secondary for SBI).
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed ops headline; digital buffers limit equity impact—low strength; Vi funding is not SBI equity catalyst.

unknowns: Strike actual branch closure intensity varies by location

fields.headline: ITC raises Classic Connect / Gold Flake Superstar MRPs mid-Sep as staggered cigarette tax pass-through continues
fields.summary: Channel/broker checks around 16 Sep 2026: Classic Connect 20s MRP to ~₹428 from ~₹390; Gold Flake Superstar 10s to ~₹89 from ~₹79, part of staggered pass-through after Feb 2026 cigarette tax shock. Management had indicated ~50–60% of tax already passed; brokers estimate ~60–70% after this round with more hikes possible in Q2/Q3 FY27. Q1 cigarette EBIT was already pressured (~35% YoY drop in coverage); volume risk remains the offset.
fields.why_for_verdict: Price hikes support margin recovery path but are source/channel-confirmed not a formal exchange PR; volume elasticity still the risk.

unknowns: Not a numbered exchange filing—based on channel checks/wires
Further pass-through quantum and volume hit uncertain

fields.headline: BoB incorporates BOB Pension Fund Management Co. (21 Sep); ₹80.10 Cr for 80.10% stake by 31 Dec; UFBU strike still on watch
fields.summary: Exchange-linked 21 Sep 2026 disclosure: Bank of Baroda incorporated BOB Pension Fund Management Company Ltd (RoC certificate same day) to act as PFRDA-regulated PFM; proposed cash subscription ₹80.10 Cr for 80.10% by 31 Dec 2026 (RBI approval Jul 10; PFRDA sponsor letter May 5). Separately UFBU strike windows incl. 28–30 Sep remain a near-term ops overlay; earlier ₹6,000 Cr AT1/Tier-II programme stays approved without a fresh Sep allotment found.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed new subsidiary is strategic but small vs balance sheet—low strength; strike is ops noise only.

unknowns: Subsidiary yet to commence operations
No Sep 2026 AT1 allotment confirmation found

fields.headline: PNB establishes $1.5 bn EMTN programme; Moody’s/Fitch/CareEdge ratings assigned mid-Sep
fields.summary: PNB informed exchanges that its USD 1.5 billion Euro Medium Term Note programme (set up 16 Sep 2026) received Moody’s (P)Baa3, Fitch BBB- and CareEdge BBB+/Stable on 17 Sep, disclosed 18 Sep. No tranche issuance yet. Bank also flagged possible disruption around UFBU strike dates.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed MTN platform and investment-grade-style ratings open FCY funding optionality; actual raise still pending.

unknowns: No EMTN tranche priced yet

fields.headline: Canara Bank raises ₹2,042 Cr via 8.10% Basel III AT1 bonds (allotment 18 Sep)
fields.summary: Canara Bank completed EBP bidding on 16 Sep 2026 for perpetual AT1 bonds (₹2,000 Cr base + ₹42 Cr greenshoe), raising ₹2,042 Cr at 8.10% coupon; deemed allotment/pay-in 18 Sep, proposed NSE listing, issuer call 18 Sep 2031.
fields.why_for_verdict: Fresh confirmed AT1 capital raise strengthens CET1/AT1 stack; coupon and size disclosed.

fields.headline: ONGC reports gas strike at deepwater MN-DW18-1 well off Odisha (Samudra Manthan)
fields.summary: Company statement covered by TOI: first Samudra Manthan well in Mahanadi Offshore Basin (~43 km off Odisha) flowed gas from 1,441–1,452 m interval after strike on 18 Sep 2026; drilled to 1,623 m. Monetisation subject to appraisal/commercial evaluation.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed discovery news; commercial reserves/size not yet proven—medium horizon, med strength.

unknowns: Commercial resource size and development timeline pending appraisal

fields.headline: NTPC group capacity to 91,164 MW after Gujarat RE CODs; Mouda 400 MWh BESS contract terminated
fields.summary: Exchange-linked disclosure (via NGEL, 18–19 Sep): 68.22 MW Dahod solar third-party capacity and 9.45 MW Vanki wind COD lift group installed capacity to 91,164 MW. Separately on 21 Sep reports, NTPC terminated GRIL’s ₹413.37 Cr Mouda BESS EPC for default and encashed ~₹91 Cr securities, with re-tender planned.
fields.why_for_verdict: Capacity adds are bullish for RE growth; BESS termination is ops/execution noise, not core generation hit.

fields.headline: POWERGRID approves up to ₹5,000 Cr 84th series private bond issue (10-year)
fields.summary: On 21 Sep 2026 POWERGRID approved issuance of its 84th bond series via private placement: base ₹1,000 Cr with ₹4,000 Cr greenshoe (up to ₹5,000 Cr / Rs 50 bn). Unsecured NCD, taxable, 10-year tenor with annual redemption from year 4; coupon via EBP bidding; proposed BSE/NSE listing.
fields.why_for_verdict: Routine confirmed funding approval; equity impact typically muted until deployment news.

unknowns: Coupon/final allotment size pending EBP

fields.headline: CIL Aug SWMA e-auction at ~59% premium (39% allocation); Reuters flags ~40% of coal plants critically low stocks
fields.summary: Company/auction data early Sep: August SWMA e-auction allocated ~82.76 lt of ~210.66 lt offered (~39%) at ~59% average premium over notified price. Parallel Reuters (21 Sep) reported ~74 coal-fired plants with critically low stocks amid monsoon/logistics strains—sector offtake urgency overlay rather than a CIL order win. Aug production soft YoY in MoC stats while offtake held up in other wires.
fields.why_for_verdict: High auction premiums support realisation narrative; plant stock stress can lift offtake urgency but also flags logistics risk.

unknowns: Plant-level stock data via Reuters/CEA-style datasets
No fresh CIL price guidance found this pass

fields.headline: IOC board approves ₹2,448.70 Cr Kochi–Thoothukudi natural gas pipeline (424.65 km)
fields.summary: On 21 Sep 2026 IOC board gave investment approval for KTPL: estimated cost ₹2,448.70 Cr, length 424.65 km, system capacity 6.84 MMSCMD (incl. ≥1.71 MMSCMD common carrier), linking Kochi LNG terminal to southern TN/Kerala demand centres after PNGRB authorisation.
fields.why_for_verdict: Board-approved capex on gas midstream is confirmed positive for long-term gas network; construction timetable not in filing.

unknowns: Commissioning schedule/financing mix not disclosed in summaries reviewed

fields.headline: BPCL firms ~₹1.45 lakh Cr Andhra greenfield 9 MTPA refinery-petchem cost; final EC eyed end-Sep
fields.summary: Mid-Sep 2026 (around 16 Sep) wires: CMD Sanjay Khanna told AP CM Naidu the Ramayapatnam-area greenfield 9 MTPA refinery-cum-petrochemical project (Prakasam–Nellore) is estimated at ~₹1.45 lakh Cr; final environmental clearance expected by end-Sep with investment cost to be firmed after EIL study in Oct. Broader Project Aspire also cites Kochi 15.5→17 MTPA and Bina expansion; Q1 FY27 loss context from elevated crude remains a near-term margin watch.
fields.why_for_verdict: Large confirmed project planning milestone, but FID/EC still pending and near-term refining margins pressured by >$100 Brent.

unknowns: Final EC and Oct EIL cost firm-up pending
Construction start timing not locked

fields.headline: No fresh Sep 2026 IRFC deal filing located; AUM/~₹5 Tn target and May $1.1 bn JPY ECB remain backdrop
fields.summary: This research pass did not find a September 2026 exchange catalyst. Closest solid items: management/AUM commentary targeting ~₹5 trillion scale into Sep 2026 with diversified infra lending; and 21 May 2026 signing of five-year unsecured JPY ECB equivalent to $1.1 bn arranged by SBI, HDFC Bank, SMBC and DBS. FY27 borrowing-plan notes exist but are not a 21 Sep event.
fields.why_for_verdict: Thin for DeskJob date—May ECB/AUM targets are confirmed but stale vs 21 Sep; treat as low-strength funding backdrop only.

unknowns: No Sep 2026 primary IRFC order/bond allotment found in WebSearch this pass
Exact INR equivalent of May ECB varies with FX

fields.headline: REC completes India’s first SEBI-sandbox tokenised corporate bond issue (~₹500 Cr @ 7.30%)
fields.summary: On 7 Sep 2026 REC said it raised ~₹500 Cr (base ~₹100 Cr + greenshoe ~₹400 Cr) in tokenised corporate bonds under SEBI Regulatory Sandbox; ~8x oversubscribed vs ~₹796 Cr bids; 7.30% coupon, tenor 1y9m; same-day pay-in/allotment/listing on NSE and BSE. Separately PFC–REC merger path remains a medium-horizon structural watch.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed innovative funding success; size modest vs loan book so strength med not high.

fields.headline: PFC–REC merger: Presidential consent already granted; scheme still needs remaining clearances
fields.summary: Presidential consent for merging REC into PFC was intimated around 10 Jun 2026; boards later approved a swap of 88 PFC shares per 100 REC. As of late Sep the combination still requires shareholder/creditor/regulatory steps; expected effectiveness often cited toward FY28 start subject to approvals. No fresh Sep bond allotment located beyond routine interest/redemption notices.
fields.why_for_verdict: Structural M&A path is officially advanced but not closed; Sep tape lacks a fresh PFC-only deal catalyst.

unknowns: Effective date and final regulatory path still open
No Sep 2026 primary PFC issuance catalyst found

fields.headline: NMDC targets ~60 MT iron ore FY27; Aug output +21% YoY to 4.07 MT; chairman reiterates 21 Sep
fields.summary: Provisional Aug data (1–2 Sep): iron ore production 4.07 MT (+~21% YoY), sales 3.58 MT (+~6%); Apr–Aug output 23.23 MT (+26%) vs sales 18.72 MT (+2%)—production outpacing sales. On 20–21 Sep chairman Amitava Mukherjee reiterated FY27 ~60 MT target (~20% YoY vs ~53 MT prior year) via existing mines plus NCL JV, with 100 MT by 2030–31 still the long goal; EC applications for some deposits underway.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed volume ramp and explicit FY27 target are constructive; sales lag and steel-cycle pricing still cap strength at med.

unknowns: Realisation/pricing for Aug–Sep not isolated in this pass
EC timelines for expansion deposits open

fields.headline: VEDL promoter releases encumbrance on 51.93% stake after $1.1 bn bond repay (eff. 17 Sep); other pledges remain
fields.summary: Regulatory disclosure covered 18 Sep (updated 21 Sep): encumbrances released over 51.93% of VEDL capital held by Twin Star/Welter/VH Mauritius II after full repayment of $1.1 bn guaranteed senior bonds (9.475% 2030 + 9.850% 2033) of Vedanta Resources Finance II PLC; effective 17 Sep. Release also covers demerged entities listed 15 Jun. Filing notes other encumbrances from prior facilities may still subsist; separate Sep tap/$400 mn-linked covenants reported on demerged Aluminium Metal shares.
fields.why_for_verdict: Confirmed bond repay + partial encumbrance release is credit-positive, but residual pledges/new covenants keep sentiment mixed.

unknowns: Other subsistence encumbrances quantum not fully enumerated
USD/INR for remaining VRL debt not restated here

fields.headline: YES Bank Q1 FY27 PAT ~₹1,071 Cr (+~34% YoY); FCNR(B) mobilisation cited ~₹32,700 Cr; ₹16,000 Cr raise enabling only
fields.summary: Reported Q1 FY27 net profit ~₹1,071 Cr with improving asset-quality ratios in wires; CET1 cited ~14%. Secondary/broker notes estimate ~₹32,700 Cr FCNR(B) deposits under RBI swap window (~10.4% of deposits). Shareholders earlier backed board resolutions including a proposed up-to-₹16,000 Cr fund-raise envelope (equity+debt caps as disclosed at AGM)—enabling, not executed. No fresh 21 Sep price-sensitive breakthrough filing isolated; avoid penny momentum hype.
fields.why_for_verdict: Earnings/FCNR narrative constructive but not a fresh 21 Sep breakout; capital raise enabling only—keep strength low for penny risk.

unknowns: FCNR ₹32,700 Cr figure is broker/secondary estimate—verify vs bank disclosure before sizing
Exact Q1 filing PDF not re-fetched this pass

fields.headline: SBI-led lenders weighing ~₹35,000 Cr / $3.5 bn debt package for Vodafone Idea CapEx—still contingent
fields.summary: Bloomberg/CNBC-TV18-style wires in Sep: SBI said to be in-principle anchor (~₹7,000 Cr share cited in some reports) for a ~₹35,000 Cr consortium facility for network CapEx, with contours possibly finalising into Oct, subject to other banks, documentation, guarantees and promoter leadership conditions. Not a completed disbursement or company exchange confirmation of drawdown.
fields.why_for_verdict: Material if closed, but status is rumored/in-principle only—strictly not confirmed; high binary risk for penny name.

unknowns: No confirmed full consortium sanction+disbursement as of 21 Sep research
Guarantee/promoter conditions unresolved in press accounts
